title: The Space layout editor shows every Contact form field, including the website Contact page photo

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-07 16:17 ('I'm not seeing all that'): the Contact form tile on /spaces/<slug>/manage/layout showed only the two toggles. LIVE-839 follow-up.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: on the Space layout editor the Contact form block's tile showed only 'Ask for a phone number' and 'Ask for a message'. Its heading, intro, labels, thank-you message and the new 'Website Contact page photo' could not be edited, because the tile dropped every text and photo field on the assumption the canvas offers slots, and a rail-only block's canvas is a read-only preview. block-edit-panel already honoured RAIL_ONLY_BLOCK_IDS; the canvas editor's tile did not. THE FIX: the tile keeps every field of a rail-only block (blockEditsAllFieldsInRail) and draws its text fields.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/space-canvas/space-canvas-editor.tsx','utf8');if(!/railOnly \? fieldsForBlock\(id\)/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-840: the layout editor tile still hides a rail-only block s fields');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (the tile filters every block through isRailField); passes once this lands.
